title: 買

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩和主角媽媽在菜攤或家裡準備買菜，桌上或手上只有一小把硬幣，媽媽和小女孩一起看著錢，像是在確認這點錢買菜夠不夠。不可有價目表、文字、數字、招牌、品牌或標籤。
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L233-S01 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Protagonist little girl and protagonist mother are preparing to buy vegetables at a simple vegetable stall or home table. There is only a small handful of plain coins on the table or in their hands. Mother and daughter look at the coins together, clearly checking whether this small amount of money is enough to buy vegetables.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl from L154/L162/L163 family continuity, wearing a pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, and small pink hair clip. Protagonist mother from L154/L162/L163 family continuity, warm family role, practical home clothing such as a soft cardigan or apron, distinct from teachers and passersby. L058 images are style anchors only, not character identity references.
Composition: center the coins, simple vegetables, mother, and little girl; keep all meaning-bearing objects large and phone-readable with safe margins.
Style/medium: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration matching L058 style traits: soft transparent watercolor, delicate colored-pencil linework, warm clean lighting, detailed but uncluttered.
Constraints: no price list, text, numbers, signs, labels, logos, brands, watermarks, readable marks, store signs, or currency numbers.

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩和主角媽媽在鞋店或家裡看一雙新鞋，媽媽溫和地表示錢不夠，暫時不能買。畫面要清楚呈現「想買新鞋但錢不夠」。鞋盒、鞋子、牆面不可有文字、數字、價格、品牌或標籤。
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L233-S02 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Protagonist little girl and protagonist mother look at one pair of new shoes at home or in a very plain shoe area. Mother gently indicates that there is not enough money, so they cannot buy the new shoes for now. The scene must clearly show wanting to buy new shoes but not having enough money.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl from L154/L162/L163 family continuity, pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. Protagonist mother from L154/L162/L163 family continuity, warm family role, practical soft cardigan or apron, not a teacher or clerk. L058 style anchors only.
Composition: new shoes centered with a tiny group of plain coins nearby, mother and little girl visible, expressions gentle and understandable, safe margins.
Style/medium: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration, soft clean palette, delicate colored-pencil lines.
Constraints: no text, numbers, prices, signs, labels, shoe brand, shoebox writing, wall writing, logos, tags, watermarks, or readable marks.

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩剛買了一瓶沒有標籤的水，手上或桌上只剩很少硬幣。可有主角媽媽在旁邊看著她數錢。畫面重點是「買水後錢只剩一點」。水瓶、硬幣、桌面不可有文字、數字、刻度、品牌或標籤。
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story

Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Protagonist little girl has just bought one plain unlabeled water bottle. On the table or in her hand there are only a few plain coins left. Protagonist mother may stand beside her watching as the girl counts the remaining money. The focus is: after buying water, only a little money remains.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl from L154/L162/L163 family continuity, pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. Protagonist mother from L154/L162/L163 family continuity, warm practical family role. L058 style anchors only.
Composition: center the plain water bottle, a very small remaining coin group, and the girl counting; make the leftover money visually clear without using numbers; safe margins.
Style/medium: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration, soft transparent watercolor, delicate colored-pencil lines.
Constraints: no bottle label, text, numbers, scale marks, brand, logo, price tag, table writing, watermarks, readable marks, or printed symbols.

sentences.text: 衣服買太多，只穿了一半。
sentences.spokenText: 衣服買太多只穿了一半
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩的房間裡有一小堆新買或剛買來的衣服，一部分已經穿過或拿出來搭配，另一部分還整齊放著沒穿。主角媽媽在旁邊看著，像是在提醒衣服買太多。畫面要清楚表現「衣服買太多，只穿了一半」，不可有文字、數字、品牌、吊牌或標籤。
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L233-S04 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. In the protagonist little girl's room, there is a small pile of newly bought clothes. About half of the clothes have clearly been worn or taken out for outfit matching, and the other half are still neatly folded and unworn. Protagonist mother watches gently as if reminding the girl that too many clothes were bought and only half were worn.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl from L154/L162/L163 family continuity, pink jacket or casual home outfit retaining her pink hair clip and child identity. Protagonist mother from L154/L162/L163 family continuity, warm family role, practical home clothing. L058 style anchors only.
Composition: center the two contrasting clothing groups: worn/taken-out clothes and neatly unworn clothes; mother and girl visible; phone-readable square crop with safe margins.
Style/medium: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration, cozy Taiwan home interior, soft lines and warm light.
Constraints: no text, numbers, clothing brand, tag, label, hanger tag, printed shirt words, logos, watermarks, readable marks, or price labels.

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩坐在家裡或教室看一本新書，書翻到中間，後半本明顯還沒看完。可有書籤夾在中間。畫面重點是「新書還剩一半沒看」。書頁與封面不可有可讀文字、數字、品牌或標籤。
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L233-S05 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Protagonist little girl sits at home or in a classroom reading one new book. The book is open near the middle, with the unread back half visibly remaining. A simple bookmark may sit at the middle. The focus is: the new book still has half left unread.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl from L154/L162/L163 family continuity, pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. If the setting is classroom, do not include a teacher unless needed. L058 style anchors only.
Composition: center the girl and the open book; clearly show the remaining back half thickness without any readable page content; safe margins for square app card.
Style/medium: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration matching L058 style, soft transparent watercolor and delicate colored-pencil linework.
Constraints: no readable text, letters, numbers, zhuyin, page writing, book title, brand, label, watermark, logo, or readable marks on cover or pages.
